name: Platform dropdown leads to a warning-first install guide
description: An anonymous employee opens the alternate-platform dropdown, closes it with Escape, starts the primary download and uses the resulting install guide; the red security warning must lead the install steps and the extra security help must expand on demand. Do not inspect or run an OS-native installer.

planSteps.description: Open the arrow button beside the primary download action.
Press Escape to close the alternate-platform dropdown.
Click the primary platform download action to open its installation guide. Ignore the downloaded file; do not launch it.
Expand the extra help with security prompts disclosure beneath the three installation steps.
Expand the SHA-256 verification disclosure to read the command for this platform.

The install guide shows a red outlined, pale red security-warning panel with a warning triangle directly beneath the thank-you heading, above the numbered installation steps. Its visible instructions distinguish antivirus or malware blocks from unknown-publisher prompts and tell the employee not to disable protection.

The expanded security-help section explains the selected platform's prompts, and the expanded verification section shows a platform-appropriate checksum command and working published-checksums link. The page remains in the selected platform's guide.
